title: Baseball Boots
hook: Boots 想参加大棒球赛，可他总打不中球。Dora 陪他一路练习，还找到了教练。

cells.en: Dora has a glove and a cap. “You get to catch the ball, too.”
cells.cn: Dora 戴好帽子和手套：“你也要去接球哦。”

cells.en: Boots holds the bat and sings, “When I hit the baseball, all will cheer.”
cells.cn: Boots 举着球棒唱：“等我打中棒球，大家都会为我欢呼。”

cells.en: “Who's the guy you need to know when you've got a place to go?” Map!
cells.cn: “想去一个地方，要问谁呢？”——地图！

cells.en: Six baseballs sit on the board. “Count with me in Spanish!”
cells.cn: 计分板上有六个棒球：“跟我用西班牙语数一数！”

cells.en: “To open this gate, find the green square.” A turtle swims by.
cells.cn: “要开这扇门，先找到绿色的正方形。”一只乌龟游了过来。

cells.en: Backpack, Backpack! Out come a mitt, a ball, tape and a bat.
cells.cn: 背包，背包！——手套、棒球、胶带和球棒都出来了。

cells.en: The coach says, “Remember, Boots. You have three tries to hit the ball.”
cells.cn: 教练说：“记住，Boots，你有三次机会打到球。”

cells.en: “When you see the ball, yell Pelota!” Boots stands at the plate.
cells.cn: “看到球就喊 Pelota（球）！”Boots 站到了击球位上。

cells.en: “Four stars!” Dora and Boots jump and cheer after the big game.
cells.cn: “四颗星星！”大比赛结束后，Dora 和 Boots 又跳又欢呼。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baseball Boots”.
ending: In the end, Boots plays in the big baseball game and everybody cheers for him. My favorite part is ______.
